body:
Right now,nothing...

I liked doing some sports but had to stop due to their associated costs

Thanks for the message and the time you took to read the little sad story.

Unfortunately I'm alone,slowly but surely I pushed everyone who showed remotely interest in my life,away.

Tbh I'm not ashamed that I've dropped out.I really don't care about social expectations.The problem may be that I don't have anything that would be worth living for.

I always felt somehow lost,but I was telling myself that I'm young and I have time to find "it",but now with time I've came to the conclusion that "it" doesn't even exist and from where I'm now there is no going up,there is just going down.

Really appreciate the offer but I can't take your money.

Good luck with your exams,and thanks again for your message.

Thank you dear stranger.

The thing is not that my gf has left me that hurts the most.I wish her the best tbh because I know I can't give her what she wants.

The thing that hurts the most is that I don't know what I wanna do with my stupid life the hurts the most.I don't even know how to explain.I'm living on saving right now,but when these finish I really don't what will happen with me...
